title: A picture Tracy retitled and the customer deleted for good stays whole in the copy: row, meta and files
steps: Run the live-sync-wordpress-flow case for #223: a picture on both sides is synced, Tracy retitles it, the customer deletes its row, meta and files on live, sync again.
expect: One kept place db:wp_posts:["5"] delete-modify; the copy keeps the title, both meta rows and both files; the log says 2 files of kept Media Library items stay.
evidence: Issue #223 re-test: the kept row had lost both meta rows and its file

tests: WordPress: a picture Tracy retitled and the customer deleted for good on the live site stays whole
